aboutParagraph1: I've been fascinated by the world of media and computers since I was a child. I am passionate about web development using Angular, Firebase, Laravel, and Bootstrap, and I am also increasingly interested in mobile applications, especially with Swift.
aboutParagraph2: In 2023, I completed a video editing course at TV2, where I learned a lot about creative storytelling and technical skills.
aboutParagraph3: In the same year, I started studying software development and testing at BZSH Külkereskedelmi Technikum, where I graduated with a 93% result, strengthening my knowledge in modern software development.
aboutParagraph4: Since September 2025, I have been studying Computer Engineering at Óbuda University, Neumann János Faculty of Informatics. I enjoy exploring new technologies, working on creative projects, and I am always excited to take on new challenges – feel free to reach out!
